purpose: Experiment E-SPN-0200 in the spin arena: explores whether a light register pair under a weak Coulomb pull, one level tracked by its overlap with a fixed reference, brings R down to tan m / m: partial, the Darwin-corrected excess falls 1.545, 0.410, 0.169 over the unambiguous radii $a_B$ 6, 8 and 12 (log-log slope -3.13, so no kill), but R is still 16% above tan m / m at $a_B$ 12.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
